slots_and_copies.name: chunk_stream_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single linear stream of 11 chunks (no slots/copies/mirroring). FUN_0802ea38 computes offsets by accumulation (offset[n+1]=offset[n]+12+block_size*block_count), verifies each chunk with FUN_0802eb00, and rewrites only failing chunks from RAM via FUN_0802ec10. Tail 0x7F50..0x7FFF (176 B, 0xFF) is unused by traced code.

io_driver_functions.notes: SRAM write core: WAITCNT SRAM bits set (& mask | 3 via unresolved _DAT), then byte-copy loop. Byte-wide only, as required for GBA SRAM.
SRAM read: WAITCNT setup + stack-trampoline reader executed via func_0x08044020. Callers textual (func_0x spelling, absent from callgraph callees).
SRAM verify/compare counterpart (0=match), same trampoline construction as reader.
Write-with-verify wrapper: FUN_080435b4 + FUN_08043624, up to 3 attempts.
Byte-sum: acc=(u16)byte+acc per byte, seed passed in, 16-bit truncation. Proven against all 22 chunk checksums.
Descriptor lookup: linear search of 11x20-byte table by magic at entry+0; returns index or 0xFFFFFFFF.
Whole-chunk verify: header magic/version/block_size/count vs descriptor, payload byte-sum vs header+10; scratch via malloc FUN_08030564/free FUN_0803094c; data not retained.
Whole-chunk writer: checksum over RAM blocks (index*desc+16 stride via func_0x08044018), blocks via FUN_08043688, 12-byte header written last.
Single-record read: index<desc+12 bound, header shape check only (no checksum), reads chunk_offset+12+block_size*index.
Recomputes whole-chunk byte-sum from SRAM-resident blocks; returns sum without comparing.
Single-record write: header check, block via FUN_08043688, checksum fix-up via FUN_0802eda0, header rewrite.
Boot validate-all: builds SRAM offset table, verify-or-rewrite each of 11 chunks. The blank-revert mechanism.

caller_chains.trigger_context: boot/main entry (no traced callers); save validation before game init completes
caller_chains.how_mapped: Textual func_0x0802ea38 call inside FUN_0802e928 (callgraph records no edge for func_0x spellings); FUN_0802ea38 loops 11 magics calling func_0x0802eb00 and func_0x0802ec10 on failure. Mutates SRAM only; rewritten bytes come from current (default) RAM.

Callgraph FUN_0802e928->FUN_08000f90 plus textual func_0x0802ece8(_DAT_08001084,0,_DAT_08001088) in FUN_08000f90; field unpacking read directly from FUN_08000f90 body. Chunk magic literal unresolved; OPTS is best-fit hypothesis only.

ram_fields_updated: 64-byte RAM record buffer := 0x01 x63 + 0x00 at +0x3F (before write; refilled on read-back failure)
caller_chains.how_mapped: Textual func_0x0800adb4 in FUN_08000f90; FUN_0800adb4 body shows fill loop, func_0x0802eef0(magic,0,buf) write, func_0x0802ece8(magic,0,buf) read-back. Writes SRAM every boot regardless of corruption. CARD payload[0:64] matches the pattern (hypothesis).

open_questions: Purpose of byte at 0x7FFC (0x60 vs 0xE0, bit-7-only difference): not a deterministic content checksum (chunk areas identical), no traced reader/writer, yet packet probe reports blank-revert on mutation. Generation/flag toggle vs SRAM residue vs untraced whole-image check — discriminated by fuzzing target at offset 32764.
RAM mirror base addresses and descriptor field +16 (RAM record stride) values: all behind unresolved _DAT_ literals in the trace-guided decompilation; no 0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx address can be stated.
Identity of Chain B (FUN_08000f90 record fetch, _DAT_08001084) and Chain C (FUN_0800adb4, _DAT_0800ae18) magics: OPTS and CARD are pattern/size hypotheses, not proven.
Internal field semantics of LINE/SEAS/WSLU blobs and 16-byte BATT/PITC/WBAT/WPIT record layouts: both samples are the blank state (stat tables all zero), so no populated-record diff exists.
Whether SEAS being byte-identical to the first 2736 bytes of LINE is a shared default template or runtime derivation; requires a populated save to observe divergence.
Gameplay-time writers beyond the traced boot/record paths: decompiled.c covers 364 trace-guided functions, not the full ROM; untraced callers of FUN_0802ec10/FUN_0802eef0 may exist.
WAITCNT register value/mask and SRAM base pointer values behind _DAT_ symbols in FUN_080435b4/FUN_08043550/FUN_08043624 (shape indicates 0x04000204 | 3 on SRAM wait bits; literal unproven).
Meaning of header version/flag field (0 for 16-byte-record tables, 1 for single-block blobs): correlation verified, semantics unknown.
